description: Synthetic sesslint.outcome-contract.v1 schema parity. Constraints and expected rejections come from the pinned schema. Documents are constructed objects, not contract_from_dict output. No session text is stored.
known_parity_gaps: contract.py imports sesslint._canonical_codec at module scope. That import is refused, so contract_from_dict and canonical_json_bytes are not executed. This checker writes no canonical bytes.
tests/outcome/test_outcome_contract.py is not one schema judgment. Every row is not_applicable. The orders fixture is not copied.
Bound order, on_time without due, duplicate ids, key width, and a decisive condition are producer rules. The schema does not state them, so those documents are accepted.
Duplicate JSON object keys are a syntax refusal. Python json.loads keeps the last key, so that case is not a vector.
pattern \S is unanchored. U+001C, U+001D, U+001E, U+001F, U+0085, and U+FEFF are a Python re / ECMA-262 split. Those strings are unsupported, not vectors.
i128::MIN is inside the signed 128-bit range, but the checker does not prove that token. It is not a vector.
The 1 MiB load limit and the UTF-8 file check are producer behavior. validate reads one Unicode string.
